description: The specific section of the Financial Conduct Authority's rulebook governing the handling of complaints that the bank's policy must adhere to.

name: FirstUK Bank Complaints Policy
description: A formal policy governing the fair and efficient handling of customer complaints at FirstUK Bank. It establishes the mandatory procedures for the receipt, investigation, resolution, and regulatory reporting of complaints to ensure compliance with FCA requirements.

name: Complaint Handling Policy
description: A formal policy establishing the procedures for handling customer complaints at FirstUK Bank. Its primary objectives are prompt acknowledgement, thorough investigation, fair resolution, and regulatory reporting to the FCA.
context: To establish complaint handling procedures that:

name: Prompt Acknowledgement of Complaints
description: A requirement that all customer complaints must be acknowledged by the bank in a prompt manner.

name: Thorough Investigation of Complaint Issues
description: A mandate ensuring that all issues raised within a complaint are investigated thoroughly before resolution.

name: Fair Resolution of Complaints
description: A requirement that the outcome of the complaint handling process must be fair to the customer.

name: Regulatory Reporting of Complaints to FCA
description: An obligation to report complaint-related data or specific incidents to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) as required by regulation.

name: Prevention of Repeat Complaint Issues
description: A requirement to use complaint data and outcomes to implement changes that prevent the recurrence of the same issues.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The regulatory body to which FirstUK Bank must report complaint handling activities as required.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The external regulatory authority responsible for receiving required reports regarding the bank's complaint handling.

name: Complaining Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates a complaint and with whom the bank seeks to maintain a relationship through fair resolution.

name: Customer Complaints Policy
description: The governing policy document defining the scope and application of the bank's complaint handling process. It covers all customer complaints across all channels, staff, and products.
context: Applies to: - All customer complaints (product, service, policy)

name: All Staff
description: The collective group of all bank employees to whom the complaints policy applies, regardless of their specific department or role.

name: Customer
description: The subject of the policy who may lodge complaints regarding products, services, or policies through various bank channels.
context: Applies to: - All customer complaints (product, service, policy)

name: Bank Accounts
description: All customer accounts that fall within the scope of the complaints policy.
context: Applies to: ... - All accounts and products

name: Banking Products
description: All banking products offered by FirstUK Bank that are subject to the complaints policy.
context: Applies to: - All customer complaints (product, service, policy)
Applies to: ... - All accounts and products

name: FirstUK Bank Complaints Policy
description: The governing policy document outlining FirstUK Bank's commitment to treating customer complaints seriously and ensuring fair resolution within mandated regulatory timeframes.
context: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.

name: Fair and Timely Resolution of Customer Complaints
description: A mandatory requirement that all customer complaints must be handled seriously and resolved in a fair manner, adhering to the timeframes set by regulatory authorities.
context: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The corporate entity responsible for the serious treatment and fair resolution of customer complaints in accordance with regulatory standards.
context: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.

name: Bank Customer
description: The subject of the policy whose complaints must be treated seriously and resolved fairly by the bank.
context: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously

name: FirstUK Bank Complaints Policy
description: The governing policy document defining what constitutes a complaint within FirstUK Bank regarding its services or products.
context: Any expression of dissatisfaction by customer about FirstUK Bank's service or product.

name: Customer
description: The individual or entity who expresses dissatisfaction regarding the bank's services or products.
context: Any expression of dissatisfaction by customer about FirstUK Bank's service or product.

name: FirstUK Bank Product
description: Any banking product offered by FirstUK Bank that may be the subject of a customer complaint.
context: Any expression of dissatisfaction by customer about FirstUK Bank's service or product.

name: Service Complaints
description: Risks associated with the quality of service delivery, including processing delays, misinformation, and system availability.

name: Product Complaints
description: Risks relating to the administration and understanding of banking products, specifically regarding interest rates, fees, and terms.

name: Financial Loss
description: Risks involving direct monetary loss to the customer or bank resulting from unauthorized activity, fraud, or accounting errors.

name: Unauthorized Transaction
description: A financial event categorized under Financial Loss where a transaction occurs without the account holder's authorization.

name: Fraudulent Activity
description: Financial events involving deceptive practices resulting in financial loss.

name: Complaint Receipt & Logging Policy
description: The governing policy defining the acceptable channels and procedures for customers to submit complaints to FirstUK Bank and the requirement for those complaints to be logged.

name: Immediate Logging of In-Person Branch Complaints
description: Complaints received in person at a bank branch must be logged immediately.

name: Recording and Logging of Telephone Complaints
description: Complaints received via the dedicated phone line (0800-555-2265) must be recorded and logged.

name: Immediate Logging of Email Complaints
description: Complaints submitted via email to support@firstuk.bank must be logged immediately.

name: Complaint Logging Mechanism
description: The operational process of capturing and recording customer complaints across various channels to ensure they are tracked.

name: Customer
description: The individual utilizing the provided channels to submit a complaint to the bank.

name: Complaints Handling Policy
description: A formal policy governing the immediate actions required when a customer complaint is received, focusing on recording, acknowledgment, and system logging.

name: Mandatory Complaint Recording Requirements
description: Staff must record specific data points upon receipt of a complaint, including date, time, customer identity, account number, verbatim details, channel, and the receiving staff member.

name: Customer Complaint Acknowledgment Timeframes
description: Mandates specific acknowledgment windows based on the channel: immediate for branches, 24 hours for phone, automated for email, and 2 business days for letters.
context: Branch: Immediate verbal acknowledgment + written confirmation
Phone: Verbal acknowledgment + written confirmation within 24 hours
Letter: Written acknowledgment within 2 business days

name: Complaint System Logging and Assignment
description: Requires the creation of a complaint record in the CRM, assignment of a unique ID, categorization, and assignment to a handler.

name: CRM Complaint Logging
description: The use of the CRM system to create records, assign IDs, and tag complaints by category for tracking and management.

name: Complaint Handler
description: The staff member assigned to manage and resolve a specific complaint after it has been logged in the CRM.

name: Receiving Staff Member
description: The employee responsible for the initial intake, recording, and acknowledgment of the customer complaint.

name: Complaining Customer
description: The bank customer who has initiated a complaint and is entitled to acknowledgment within the specified timeframes.

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account associated with the complaint, which must be recorded during the intake process.

name: Complaint Handling Process
description: A formal policy governing the triage, assessment, and escalation of customer complaints based on severity and financial impact.

name: Initial Assessment Timeframe
description: Mandates that the initial assessment of a complaint must be completed within a window of Day 1 to Day 2.

name: Immediate Escalation of Urgent Complaints
description: Requires that complaints categorized as 'Urgent'—including those involving financial loss over £1,000, fraud, security breaches, service outages, or regulatory concerns—must be escalated to a Manager immediately.

name: Standard Complaint Processing
description: Directs that standard complaints, such as regular service issues, fee disputes under £1,000, and operational delays, should be processed normally.

name: Financial Loss
description: A risk category defined by financial loss exceeding £1,000, triggering urgent escalation.

name: Fraud and Security Breach
description: A high-severity risk involving fraud or security breaches that requires immediate action.

name: Service Outage
description: A risk category relating to the impact of service outages, classified as an urgent concern.

name: Regulatory Concern
description: A risk category involving regulatory concerns that necessitate immediate escalation to management.

name: Manager
description: The role responsible for receiving and handling escalated urgent complaints.

name: Triage by Severity
description: An operational mechanism used to categorize complaints into 'Urgent' or 'Standard' streams to determine the processing path.

name: Investigating Staff
description: Staff members responsible for conducting the investigation phase between days 2 and 5. Their duties include gathering information, reviewing records, and documenting findings to determine bank fault and financial loss.

name: Mandatory Information Gathering during Investigation
description: A requirement to perform specific information gathering activities between day 2 and day 5 of the process. This includes reviewing account records, transaction history, procedures, and interviewing staff to assess policy compliance.

name: Mandatory Investigation Documentation
description: A requirement to formally record all investigation findings. Documentation must include the applicable policy or procedure, a determination of whether FirstUK Bank is at fault, and a quantification of any financial loss.
context: Determine if FirstUK Bank at fault

name: Account Record Review
description: The operational act of reviewing account records as part of the investigation process to gather evidence and assess compliance.

name: Transaction History Audit
description: The operational act of checking transaction history to identify anomalies or evidence during the investigation phase.

name: Bank Account
description: Customer accounts whose records and transaction histories are subject to review during the investigation process.

name: Account Transaction
description: Financial transactions recorded in the bank's history that must be checked during the investigation phase.

name: FirstUK Bank Complaints Resolution Policy
description: The governing framework for resolving customer complaints at FirstUK Bank, specifically detailing the resolution phase (Days 5–8) and the potential outcomes based on fault determination.

name: Compensation and Redress for Bank Fault
description: Mandates that if FirstUK Bank is found at fault, the bank must provide full financial compensation for loss, potentially including 8% per annum interest, distress compensation, a written apology, and a process improvement plan.
context: Plus interest (8% per annum) if appropriate
Plus additional compensation if distress caused

name: Response Protocol for Customer Fault
description: Requires the bank to provide an explanation of policy/procedure and supporting evidence, politely decline compensation, and maintain an educational tone when the customer is found to be at fault.

name: Handling of Inconclusive Complaint Outcomes
description: Specifies the requirements for inconclusive cases, including explaining the evidence reviewed, acknowledging the customer's perspective, offering partial compensation if appropriate, and explaining external escalation steps.

name: External Ombudsman
description: An external body to which customers may be referred for further steps if a complaint resolution is unclear or inconclusive.

name: Complaining Customer
description: The bank customer who has filed a complaint and is the subject of the resolution process, including potential compensation or educational feedback.

name: Complaints Handling Policy
description: A formal policy governing the final response stage of the complaint handling process, specifying the mandatory content and delivery standards for written responses to customers.

name: Mandatory Content of Written Complaint Response
description: A requirement that all written responses to complaints must contain an acknowledgment, an investigation summary, a clear decision with reasoning, any applicable compensation, and escalation rights.
context: Written Response Must Include: Acknowledgment of complaint, Summary of investigation, Clear decision and reasoning, Compensation offered (if applicable), Explanation of right to escalate

name: Complaint Response Delivery Standards
description: Mandates that complaint responses be delivered via the customer's choice of email or letter, using plain language and a professional, respectful tone.

name: Complaint Response Deadline
description: Establishes a deadline for the final response to be issued by the 8th day.

name: Customer
description: The individual who has raised a complaint and is the recipient of the formal response, with the right to choose the delivery method.

name: Complaints Response Policy
description: A policy governing the timeframes and escalation procedures for responding to customer complaints in accordance with FCA requirements.

name: Financial Conduct Authority Requirements
description: The regulatory standards set by the Financial Conduct Authority that dictate the mandatory response times and notification requirements for customer complaints.

name: Simple Complaint Response Timeframe
description: Mandatory requirement to resolve simple complaints within 1 business day.

name: Standard Complaint Response Timeframe
description: Mandatory requirement to resolve standard complaints within 8 calendar days.

name: Complex Complaint Response Timeframe
description: Mandatory requirement to resolve complex complaints within 8 weeks, subject to FCA extensions.

name: Complex Investigation Extension Rule
description: The 8-week response clock can be extended by an additional 8 weeks if a complex investigation is justified and the customer agrees.
context: Can be extended 8 weeks if: Complex investigation justified, customer agrees

name: FCA Notification Obligation for Overdue Complex Complaints
description: Obligation to notify the FCA if the response timeframe for a complex complaint is exceeded.

name: Manager
description: The role responsible for handling the escalation of simple complaints.

name: Director
description: The role responsible for handling the escalation of standard complaints that remain unresolved.

name: Customer
description: The individual to whom the response is sent and who must agree to extensions for complex investigations.
context: Stops: When response sent to customer

name: Complaint Categories & Handling Policy
description: A policy governing the categorization, investigation, and resolution of customer complaints, specifically focusing on service-related issues and compensation frameworks.

name: Service Failure Risk
description: Risks associated with poor service delivery, including long wait times, provision of incorrect information, and staff misconduct.
context: Long wait, incorrect information, rude staff

name: Mandatory Investigation of Service Complaints
description: Requirement to investigate service complaints by checking timelines, reviewing procedures, assessing reasonableness, and interviewing staff where necessary.

name: Service Complaint Resolution and Compensation
description: Obligation to provide an apology and financial compensation if the bank is at fault. Compensation is capped at £100 for minor inconvenience, with higher amounts for significant distress or loss.
context: If at fault: Apology + compensation for inconvenience
Compensation: Up to £100 for minor inconvenience, more if significant distress/loss

name: Post-Complaint Process Improvement
description: Requirement to implement process improvements following a complaint to prevent the recurrence of the service failure.
context: Learning: Process improvement to prevent recurrence

name: Complaint Investigation Process
description: The operational mechanism of reviewing timelines and procedures to determine the validity of a service complaint.

name: Fee Disputes Policy
description: A policy governing the investigation and resolution of customer disputes regarding bank fees, including unexpected charges, overdraft fees, and card replacement fees.
context: Example: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee

name: Mandatory Fee Dispute Investigation Process
description: Staff must conduct a formal investigation into fee disputes by reviewing terms and conditions, verifying the correctness of the fee application, assessing disclosure clarity, and reviewing customer history.

name: Fee Dispute Resolution Requirements
description: Mandates specific outcomes based on investigation findings: decline reversal if correct per T&Cs, reverse charge and interest if an error occurred, or refund and apologize if T&Cs were unclear.
context: If fee applied correctly per T&Cs: Explain and decline reversal
If fee error: Reverse charge + interest

name: Fee Dispute Risk
description: The risk associated with incorrect fee application or lack of transparency in terms and conditions leading to customer disputes.
context: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee

name: Terms and Conditions Review
description: The operational act of reviewing the bank's formal terms and conditions to determine the validity of a fee charge.
context: If fee applied correctly per T&Cs

name: Customer History Review
description: The process of reviewing a customer's account history to inform the resolution of a fee dispute.

name: Disputing Customer
description: A customer who has raised a dispute regarding a fee charged to their account.

name: Card Product
description: Banking products subject to card replacement fees as referenced in the dispute examples.

name: Account Balance Issues Policy
description: A policy governing the investigation and resolution of account balance discrepancies, including missing credits, incorrect balances, and interest miscalculations.
context: Example: Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated

name: Mandatory Investigation of Balance Discrepancies
description: Requires a structured investigation process for balance issues involving transaction reconciliation, system record checks, calculation verification, and review of hold periods.

name: Remediation for Bank Error
description: Obligates the bank to correct the account balance and provide interest on any missing amounts when a bank error is identified.
context: If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount

name: Customer Education for Balance Misunderstandings
description: Mandates that staff explain the balance to the customer in cases of misunderstanding, emphasizing education over penalization.
context: If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)

name: Urgent IT Escalation for System Errors
description: Requires an urgent escalation to the IT department to resolve the root cause when a balance issue is determined to be a system error.
context: If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix

name: Account Balance Discrepancy
description: The risk of incorrect financial reporting to the customer, manifesting as missing credits, wrong balances, or miscalculated interest.
context: Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated

name: Transaction Reconciliation
description: The operational process of reconciling transactions to identify the source of a balance discrepancy.

name: System Record Verification
description: The process of checking internal system records to verify the accuracy of the displayed account balance.

name: IT Department
description: The technical collective responsible for fixing system errors that lead to account balance discrepancies.

name: Account Customer
description: The bank customer who may experience balance issues or misunderstandings regarding their account status.
context: If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)

name: Customer Account
description: The financial account subject to balance verification, interest calculation, and correction.
context: Correct balance + interest on missing amount

name: Fraud Policy
description: The governing policy document containing fraud-specific procedures and the overarching framework for handling fraudulent transactions.

name: Fraud Investigation Process
description: A mandatory set of steps to be followed when a customer claims a fraudulent transaction, including obtaining statements, reviewing details, and assessing fraud likelihood.

name: Confirmed Fraud Reimbursement Timeline
description: A requirement to provide full reimbursement and an apology to the customer within 10 business days once fraud is confirmed.
context: If fraud confirmed: Full reimbursement within 10 business days + apology

name: Disputed Transaction Resolution
description: The obligation to conduct further investigation and apply FCA guidance in cases where a transaction is disputed.
context: If disputed: Further investigation + FCA guidance

name: Financial Conduct Authority Guidance
description: External guidance provided by the Financial Conduct Authority used to resolve disputed transactions.
context: If disputed: Further investigation + FCA guidance

name: Fraudulent Transactions
description: The risk of unauthorized or fraudulent financial transactions claimed by customers.

name: Fraud Team
description: The specialized collective responsible for conducting detailed investigations into suspected fraud when required.

name: Claiming Customer
description: The bank customer who reports a fraudulent transaction and is the subject of the investigation and reimbursement process.

name: Fraudulent Transaction
description: A financial event reported as unauthorized or fraudulent that requires review and investigation.

name: Unauthorized Account Access Policy
description: A policy governing the response and resolution process when a customer discovers their account has been used without permission. It defines the investigation steps and the mandatory resolution actions to be taken by the bank.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

name: Unauthorized Account Access
description: A risk scenario where a customer's account is accessed and used without their permission, potentially leading to fraudulent transactions and identity theft.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

name: Immediate Account Freeze upon Unauthorized Access
description: A mandatory requirement to immediately freeze an account once unauthorized access has been identified as part of the investigation process.

name: Fraud Team Escalation Requirement
description: An obligation to escalate the case of unauthorized account access to the specialized Fraud team for further investigation.

name: Full Reimbursement of Fraudulent Transactions
description: A mandatory resolution requirement to provide full reimbursement to the customer for transactions identified as fraudulent resulting from unauthorized access.

name: Account Freeze
description: An operational safeguard used to prevent further unauthorized transactions by restricting all activity on the affected account.

name: Authentication Review
description: A security control involving the review of account authentication methods and the implementation of password changes to secure the account.

name: Account Security Reset
description: A technical control to reset security credentials and online access to ensure the unauthorized party is removed from the account.

name: Fraud Team
description: The specialized internal collective responsible for handling escalations and investigations related to unauthorized account access and fraud.

name: Law Enforcement
description: External authorities to be notified when unauthorized account access warrants legal or criminal investigation.

name: Affected Customer
description: The bank customer who has discovered that their account has been used without permission and is the subject of the reimbursement and security reset process.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

name: Compromised Account
description: The specific customer account subject to unauthorized access, which must be frozen and reviewed for fraudulent transactions.

name: Fraudulent Transaction
description: Transactions occurring without the customer's permission that are subject to review and full reimbursement.

name: Replacement Card
description: The process of issuing a new payment card to a customer following an account takeover to replace the compromised card.

name: Complaint Escalation Policy
description: A governing framework defining the escalation paths, authority levels, and timelines for handling customer complaints based on severity and financial impact.

name: Frontline Complaint Resolution Timeline
description: Mandates that simple, low-value complaints handled by Customer Service Agents must be resolved in less than one day.
context: Frontline | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value

name: Manager Complaint Resolution Timeline
description: Mandates that moderate issues with a loss of less than £500 handled by the Complaints Manager must be resolved in less than five days.
context: Manager | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss

name: Director Complaint Resolution Timeline
description: Mandates that significant issues with a loss exceeding £500 handled by the Head of Customer Service must be resolved in less than eight days.
context: Director | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, >£500 loss

name: Executive Complaint Resolution Timeline
description: Mandates that major failures or those involving reputational risk handled by the CEO or Board be resolved within eight or more weeks.
context: Escalated | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, reputational risk

name: Mandatory Escalation Triggers
description: Defines the specific conditions that require a complaint to be escalated, including unresolved manager reviews, financial compensation over £500, regulatory concerns, media/legal involvement, or FCA escalation.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The external regulatory body to which customers may escalate complaints, triggering a mandatory internal escalation process.

name: Reputational Risk
description: Risk associated with major failures or public concerns that necessitate escalation to the CEO or Board level.

name: Customer Service Agent
description: Staff responsible for resolving simple, low-value complaints within a one-day timeframe.
context: Frontline | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value

name: Complaints Manager
description: Role responsible for resolving moderate issues with losses under £500 within five days.
context: Manager | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss

name: Head of Customer Service
description: Role responsible for resolving significant issues with losses exceeding £500 within eight days.
context: Director | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, >£500 loss

name: CEO and Board
description: The highest authority level responsible for addressing major failures and reputational risks over an 8+ week period.
context: Escalated | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, reputational risk

name: Complaining Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates a complaint or escalates a matter to the FCA.

name: Compensation Framework
description: A governing framework defining the financial compensation ranges and approval hierarchies for service delays, failures, financial losses, and distress experienced by customers.

name: Compensation for Service Delays
description: Mandates specific compensation ranges for service delays based on duration: £0–£50 for 1–2 days (inconvenience) and £50–£100 for 3–5 days (operational disruption).

name: Compensation for Service Failure
description: Mandates a compensation range of £100–£300 for service failures lasting more than 5 days, based on significant impact.

name: Compensation for Financial Loss
description: Requires the reimbursement of the full financial loss plus 8% interest in cases of errors.
context: Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest

name: Compensation for Serious Distress
description: Provides a compensation range of £250–£500+ for customers experiencing serious distress based on emotional impact.

name: Compensation Approval Hierarchy
description: Defines the mandatory approval levels based on the compensation amount: Customer Service Manager for <£100, Director for £100–£500, and CEO for >£500.

name: Board Notification for High-Value Compensation
description: Mandates that any compensation exceeding £1,000 requires both CEO approval and notification to the Board.

name: Customer Service Manager
description: The role responsible for approving compensation payments under £100.

name: Director
description: The role responsible for approving compensation payments between £100 and £500.

name: CEO
description: The role responsible for approving compensation payments exceeding £500.

name: Board
description: The governing body that must be notified of all compensation payments exceeding £1,000.

name: Customer
description: The recipient of compensation for service delays, failures, financial losses, or distress.

name: FCA Reporting Policy
description: A governing policy document defining the requirements for reporting specific categories of customer complaints to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

name: Mandatory Reporting of FCA Rule Breach Complaints
description: A mandatory requirement to report complaints to the FCA when those complaints allege breaches of FCA rules.
context: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

name: Mandatory Reporting of Financial Services Complaints
description: A mandatory requirement to report complaints to the FCA regarding the provision of financial services.

name: Mandatory Reporting of Conduct Complaints
description: A mandatory requirement to report complaints to the FCA concerning the conduct of the bank or its staff.

name: Mandatory Reporting of Complaints Causing Financial Loss
description: A mandatory requirement to report complaints to the FCA in instances where the complaint involves a financial loss.

name: Mandatory Reporting of Systemic Issues
description: A mandatory requirement to report systemic issues to the FCA.

name: Financial Conduct Authority Rules
description: The rules issued by the Financial Conduct Authority that the bank must comply with and report breaches of.
context: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The external regulatory body to which the bank is obligated to report specific categories of complaints.

name: Compliance Risk
description: The risk associated with failing to report mandatory complaints or breaching FCA rules.
context: Complaints alleging breaches of FCA rules

name: FCA Reporting Requirement (COBS)
description: A policy governing the reporting of aggregated complaint statistics to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). It defines the filing frequency and the customer's right to escalate unresolved complaints.

name: Financial Conduct Authority Conduct of Business Sourcebook
description: The regulatory framework and authority to which FirstUK Bank must report aggregated complaint statistics.

name: Quarterly Aggregated Complaint Statistics Reporting
description: Mandatory requirement for FirstUK Bank to provide aggregated complaint statistics to the FCA on a quarterly basis.
context: Who Files: FirstUK Bank (directly to FCA)

name: Customer Escalation Right After Eight Weeks
description: A provision granting customers the right to escalate their complaint to the FCA if the matter remains unresolved after a period of 8 weeks.
context: Customers can escalate to FCA if unresolved after 8 weeks

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The entity responsible for the direct filing of aggregated complaint data to the Financial Conduct Authority.
context: Who Files: FirstUK Bank (directly to FCA)

name: Customers
description: The individuals who have the right to escalate unresolved complaints to the regulator after the specified timeframe.
context: Customers can escalate to FCA if unresolved after 8 weeks

name: Aggregated Complaint Data Collection
description: The operational mechanism of aggregating complaint statistics for quarterly regulatory submission.

name: FCA Escalation Policy
description: The governing framework for handling customer-initiated escalations to the Financial Conduct Authority and the Financial Ombudsman Service when a customer remains unhappy with the bank's response.

name: Provision of FCA Contact Information
description: A mandatory requirement for FirstUK Bank to provide the customer with contact information for the Financial Conduct Authority if the customer is unhappy.
context: FirstUK Bank provides FCA contact information

name: Escalation Letter Content Requirements
description: Mandates that the escalation letter sent to the customer must include a statement of rights and specific contact details for the Financial Ombudsman Service, including phone number and website.

name: FOS Escalation Time Limit
description: A time-bound requirement stating that a customer must escalate their complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service within 6 months of receiving the final response.
context: Time limit: Customer must escalate within 6 months of final response

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The regulatory body to which customers may be directed for escalation of complaints.
context: FirstUK Bank provides FCA contact information

name: Financial Ombudsman Service
description: An independent body that provides a free service to customers for complaint escalation and issues binding decisions.
context: Customer can escalate to Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS)
FOS is independent, free to customer

name: Unhappy Customer
description: A bank customer who is dissatisfied with the bank's response and is exercising their right to escalate to the FOS.
context: Customer can escalate to Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS)
Customer must escalate within 6 months of final response

name: Complaint Data & Trends Policy
description: A policy governing the capture and tracking of complaint data and trends, specifying the mandatory data points required for recording customer complaints and their outcomes.

name: Mandatory Complaint Data Capture
description: A requirement to capture specific data points for every complaint, including the date, type, category, customer details, outcome, compensation paid, and time to resolution.

name: Complaint Tracking System
description: The operational mechanism used to capture and track complaint data, including outcomes and resolution timeframes to monitor trends.

name: Complaining Customer
description: The customer whose details must be captured as part of the complaint tracking process.

name: Complaints Policy
description: The governing policy document defining the reporting, analytics, and disclosure requirements for complaint handling, including reporting cycles for management, the Board, and the FCA.

name: Monthly Management Reporting Obligation
description: A mandatory requirement to provide a monthly report to management detailing total complaints, resolution times, upheld vs. rejected ratios, financial compensation, and trends.

name: Quarterly Board Reporting Obligation
description: A mandatory requirement to provide a quarterly report to the Board covering complaint volume trends, top complaint types, systemic issues, and corrective actions taken.

name: Annual FCA Reporting Obligation
description: A mandatory requirement to provide an annual report to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) including aggregate statistics, effectiveness of complaint handling, and process improvements.

name: Management
description: The management collective responsible for receiving and reviewing monthly reports on complaint metrics and trends.

name: Board
description: The governing Board responsible for reviewing quarterly reports on complaint volumes, systemic issues, and corrective actions.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The external regulatory body that receives an annual report on complaint handling effectiveness and aggregate statistics.

name: Financial Conduct Authority Regulations
description: The regulatory framework governing the annual reporting of complaint handling effectiveness and statistics.

name: Complaint Analytics and Reporting
description: The operational mechanism of periodic reporting (monthly, quarterly, and annually) used to monitor complaint trends and implement corrective actions.

name: Learning & Improvement Policy
description: A policy framework focused on the systemic analysis of customer complaints to drive operational improvement and corrective action within FirstUK Bank.

name: Systemic Complaint Identification
description: The bank is required to identify systemic complaints, defined as the same issue affecting multiple customers.
context: Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)

name: Root Cause Analysis Obligation
description: A mandate to perform a detailed analysis to determine the underlying root cause of identified systemic complaints.

name: Corrective Action Implementation
description: The bank must implement specific corrective actions based on the findings of the root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

name: Effectiveness Monitoring
description: A requirement to monitor the effectiveness of implemented corrective actions to ensure the systemic issue is resolved.

name: Operational Inefficiency
description: Risk associated with slow processing times leading to high volumes of customer complaints.

name: Disclosure and Transparency Risk
description: Risk arising from lack of clarity in Terms and Conditions or poor disclosure, resulting in multiple fee disputes.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

name: Fraud Risk
description: Risk of financial crime or security breaches as evidenced by customer fraud complaints.

name: SOP Review
description: The review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and resource allocation to mitigate slow processing complaints.

name: T&C Clarity Enhancement
description: Improving the clarity of Terms and Conditions and enhancing disclosure practices to reduce fee disputes.

name: Security Measure Strengthening
description: The implementation of stronger security measures in response to fraud-related complaints.

name: Complaints Handling Policy
description: A formal policy governing the responsibilities of staff regarding the handling, recording, and escalation of customer complaints to ensure respectful treatment and confidentiality.

name: All Staff
description: The collective of all bank employees who are accountable for the initial intake, recording, and escalation of customer complaints.

name: Obligation to Treat Complaints Seriously
description: A mandatory requirement for all staff to approach every customer complaint with the necessary seriousness.

name: Accurate and Prompt Complaint Recording
description: A requirement that all staff must record complaint details both accurately and in a timely manner.

name: Appropriate Complaint Escalation
description: A mandate for staff to ensure that complaints are escalated through the correct channels as required.

name: Adherence to Complaint Procedures
description: A general obligation for all staff to follow the established procedures for handling complaints.

name: Maintenance of Complaint Confidentiality
description: A requirement for staff to ensure that information related to complaints is kept confidential.

name: Respectful Treatment of Customers
description: A conduct requirement mandating that all staff treat customers with respect during the complaint process.

name: Complaint Recording
description: The operational process of documenting complaints accurately and promptly to ensure a trail of customer grievances.

name: Customer Service/Branch Staff
description: Staff members operating in customer service or branch environments responsible for the initial intake, acknowledgment, and logging of customer complaints, as well as the escalation of urgent matters.

name: Complaint Receipt and Acknowledgment Requirement
description: A mandate requiring Customer Service and Branch Staff to receive customer complaints and provide an immediate acknowledgment of the issue.

name: Complaint Logging Requirement
description: A requirement for staff to ensure that all received complaints are formally logged into the bank's system.

name: Urgent Complaint Escalation Requirement
description: An obligation for Customer Service and Branch Staff to escalate complaints identified as urgent to the appropriate authority.

name: Complaint Logging System
description: The operational system used by branch and customer service staff to record and track customer complaints.

name: Complaints Handlers
description: Staff members responsible for the end-to-end management of customer complaints, including investigation, documentation, and resolution within specified timeframes.

name: Thorough Investigation of Complaints
description: A requirement for Complaints Handlers to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the details of a customer complaint.

name: Documentation of Complaint Findings
description: An obligation for Complaints Handlers to maintain a formal record of the findings resulting from their investigation.

name: Adherence to Complaint Resolution Procedures
description: A mandate that Complaints Handlers must follow the established bank procedures to resolve a complaint.

name: Clear Customer Communication
description: A requirement for Complaints Handlers to ensure that communication with the customer regarding their complaint is clear.

name: Compliance with Complaint Resolution Timeframes
description: An obligation for Complaints Handlers to ensure that complaints are handled and resolved within the prescribed time limits.

name: Complaint Escalation Requirement
description: A requirement for Complaints Handlers to escalate a complaint to a higher authority when necessary.

name: Management
description: The management body responsible for the oversight of the complaints process, including financial approvals, trend monitoring, and regulatory liaison.

name: Approval of High-Value Complaint Payments
description: Mandatory requirement for Management to approve any complaint payments exceeding £500.

name: Complaints Trend Monitoring
description: Obligation for Management to monitor trends within the complaints data to identify systemic issues.

name: Implementation of Corrective Actions
description: Requirement for Management to implement corrective actions based on the analysis of complaints and trends.

name: Complaints Reporting to the Board
description: Mandatory reporting obligation for Management to provide updates and reports regarding complaints to the Board.

name: External Regulatory Liaison
description: Responsibility of Management to act as the point of contact and liaison with external regulatory bodies.

name: Board
description: The governing body to which Management reports regarding complaint trends and actions.

name: Training & Awareness Policy
description: A policy governing the mandatory training and awareness requirements for staff regarding complaint handling, governance, and regulatory reporting.

name: Mandatory Annual Training Requirement
description: A mandatory requirement for all staff, customer-facing staff, management, and compliance personnel to undergo annual training tailored to their specific roles.
context: Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play
Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

name: All Staff
description: The collective of all bank employees who are obligated to complete a 1-hour training session on complaint handling.

name: Customer-facing Staff
description: Staff members who interact directly with customers and are required to complete 2 hours of practical scenarios and role play training.
context: Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play

name: Management
description: Management personnel responsible for training in complaint governance and escalation procedures.

name: Compliance
description: Compliance staff responsible for training on FCA rules and reporting requirements.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

name: Financial Conduct Authority Rules
description: The rules issued by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) that govern reporting requirements and compliance standards.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

name: Staff Training Program
description: The operational mechanism of annual training sessions (including role play and practical scenarios) used to ensure staff competency in complaint handling.

name: Complaints Handling Policy
description: The governing policy document outlining the requirements for managing customer complaints, including internal audit standards and regulatory supervision by the FCA.

name: Annual Testing of Complaint Handling
description: A mandatory requirement for the bank to conduct testing of its complaint handling processes on an annual basis.

name: Sample File Review Minimum Threshold
description: A requirement to perform a sample file review consisting of 10 or more files to ensure compliance and quality.

name: Complaint Timeliness Testing
description: A requirement to test the timeliness of the complaint handling process to ensure adherence to prescribed timeframes.

name: Compensation Appropriateness Review
description: A requirement to review and ensure that the compensation provided to customers is appropriate.

name: FCA Disclosure Accuracy Verification
description: A requirement to verify the accuracy of disclosures made to the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The regulatory body responsible for supervising complaint handling and issuing consent orders in the event of violations.

name: Compliance Violation Risk
description: The risk of violating regulatory standards in complaint handling, which may lead to the issuance of consent orders by the FCA.

name: Internal Audit Monitoring
description: The operational mechanism of internal auditing used to test complaint handling, review files, and verify disclosure accuracy.

name: Internal Audit Function
description: The internal body responsible for executing annual testing, sample reviews, and timeliness checks on complaint handling.

name: FCA Supervisor
description: The external regulatory authority responsible for conducting thematic reviews and issuing consent orders.

name: FirstUK Bank Policy Review & Updates
description: The governing framework for the review and update cycle of bank policies, ensuring alignment with regulatory changes and periodic internal assessment.

name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
description: A mandatory requirement that policies must be reviewed on an annual basis or immediately upon a change in FCA regulations.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The regulatory body whose changes in guidance or rules trigger an immediate review of the bank's internal policies.

name: Escalation Matrix
description: A formal governing document that defines the escalation paths and procedures for handling issues within the bank.

name: Complaint Resolution Guide
description: A formal guidance document providing the framework and steps for resolving customer complaints.

name: Head of Customer Service
description: A senior leadership role responsible for the formal approval and sign-off of the policy document.
context: Approved by: Head of Customer Service — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Head of Compliance
description: A senior leadership role responsible for the formal approval and sign-off of the policy document to ensure regulatory alignment.
context: Approved by: Head of Compliance — Date: 2026-01-15

name: Chief Executive Officer
description: The highest executive authority responsible for the final formal approval and sign-off of the policy document.
context: Approved by: Chief Executive Officer — Date: 2026-01-15
